_comment: Independent muse.c rnd_defensive_item() witness for the Sokoban macro: #wizloaddes loads a Sokoban level file into the first dungeon level, which sets level.flags.sokoban_rules outside the Sokoban branch. Wizard genesis then creates a counted group of arch-liches; C's case 7 (wand of digging) draws rn2(4) whenever sokoban_rules is set, whatever the dungeon branch. The seed, clock, role, and name are chosen independently.
